summary: Sandbach United got their 2026/27 season off to a winning start with a 1-0 victory over Stafford Town, with a first-half goal from Tatters securing all three points and a clean sheet. The Bach put in a battling performance against a resilient visiting side, with Hatton coming close to adding a second late in the match. The opening day victory sets a positive tone as the team begins their campaign in the NWCFL.
